findings.summary: Pressing Escape in #modal-settings closes the dialog without returning focus to #btn-menu-settings.
findings.fix: Register modalSettings with bindDialogFocusRestore(modalSettings) in index.html, and set modalSettings._returnFocusEl = btnMenuSettings in js/main-menu.js when opened.

findings.summary: Opening #modal-help from Main Menu does not set _returnFocusEl or focus close button, losing focus on close.
findings.fix: In js/main-menu.js, set modalHelp._returnFocusEl = btnMenuHelp and focus btn-close-help when modalHelp.showModal() is invoked.

findings.summary: Roving tabindex callback invokes targetBtn.focus() on a detached DOM element after targetBtn.click() replaces station buttons.
findings.fix: Remove redundant targetBtn.focus() from onSelectItem callback in renderWorkbench since targetBtn.click() already queries and focuses the active station in the live DOM.

findings.summary: Station selector toolbar activates stations immediately on arrow key navigation rather than allowing arrow exploration with Space/Enter activation.
findings.fix: Separate arrow key focus movement from tool activation by removing targetBtn.click() from the arrow key handler and allowing Enter/Space to select, or change role to radiogroup.

findings.summary: Scrollable #station-items-list container lacks tabindex="0", preventing keyboard users from scrolling item contents with arrow keys or PageUp/PageDown.
findings.fix: Add tabindex="0" to #station-items-list so keyboard users can navigate and scroll the container independently.
findings.evidence: <div id="station-items-list" class="space-y-2 max-h-[180px] overflow-y-auto custom-scroll pr-1" role="list">

findings.summary: Full multi-ingredient dish names inside aria-label for both Ra khay and Xóa buttons create excessive auditory verbosity for keyboard screen reader users.
findings.fix: Shorten button aria-label to a concise item identifier (e.g. Cất món 1 ra Khay Tạm) and expose full ingredient names via aria-describedby or an item details disclosure.

findings.summary: Compound multi-ingredient names in #station-items-list are truncated with CSS ellipsis without a title attribute or focusable disclosure for sighted keyboard users.
findings.fix: Add title="${it.name}" or a keyboard-focusable inspect trigger to allow sighted keyboard users to view the complete list of ingredients in compound dishes.

passed: Station 18 (mixing_table) is fully reachable via keyboard in #station-selector-grid via Tab, Arrow keys, and End key.
Station 18 action buttons (mix_toss, knead_dough, whisk_batter) are native HTML buttons in normal Tab order and operable via Space and Enter.
Single-key shortcuts (C, K, W) for Station 18 are properly guarded against modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt, Meta) and text entry inputs.
Single-key shortcuts can be completely disabled via #setting-single-key-shortcuts meeting WCAG 2.1.4 Level A.
Focus is maintained in-place on #station-action-buttons across action executions without losing focus to document.body.
Item deletion and transfer in #station-items-list preserve focus to adjacent buttons or fall back safely to #panel-workbench.
No positive tabindex values exist in index.html or js/main-menu.js.
Global :focus-visible provides high-visibility 3px outline on all interactive kitchen elements.
notes: Multi-ingredient names on Mixing Table (Station 18) do not break the index-based focus retention logic upon item removal or staging transfer.
Station 18 actions C, K, W trigger globally when kitchen screen is active; if activeStationId is not mixing_table, K and W provide polite NVDA guidance instead of executing.
